name: Cairnheart
lore: A badger stonecarver who carries the patient strength of the old hill roads.

primary.name: Fault Steps
primary.description: Raise three successive stone faults ahead. Each enemy can take 24 damage only once per cast.

secondary.name: Stone Hoist
secondary.description: Lift the nearest aimed enemy within 220, briefly stunning it. After 1.2 seconds the cairn collapses for 36 damage within 85.

special.name: Rolling Rampart
special.description: Send a 240-unit-wide rampart forward. It hits each enemy once for 62 damage and pushes them back. Walls stop it.

passive: Bedrock: each foe hit by Fault Steps grants 5% damage reduction for 3 seconds, up to 20% per cast.

technique.name: Heavy Fault
technique.description: Fault Steps hits 25% harder, but recharges 35% slower.

final_technique.name: Standing-Stone Circle
final_technique.description: Raise a 3s stone circle with six 6-damage pulses and slow. Trades the moving rampart for a stationary siege zone.

attack.name: Standing-Stone Circle
attack.description: Raise a 3s stone circle with six 6-damage pulses and slow. Trades the moving rampart for a stationary siege zone.
